text_job: The Senior Automation Engineer - Power Systems is responsible for the design, development, and implementation of electrical systems, including generator controls, switchboards, AC/DC drives, Active Front Ends (AFE), and motor control systems. Key tasks include power system simulations, analysis of harmonics, and engineering for microgrid and utility-scale power systems. Required technical skills include extensive knowledge of electrical power systems, AC drive technology, PLC programming, and proficiency in MS Office Suite and AutoCAD Electrical. The role involves using standard field bus communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profibus, and CANBUS. A degree in Electrical Engineering or Design and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience are required, with 7+ years preferred. Experience in VFD drives, AFE systems, and power system design for industries like drilling, marine, and mining is advantageous. The position may require travel to remote locations, field support, and working in various weather conditions while adhering to safety protocols and using personal protective equipment (PPE).

Job Title: DISH Installation Technician - Field  
Company: DISH Network  

Responsibilities include delivering TV and Smart Home solutions, consulting homeowners on smart home possibilities, and ensuring a positive customer experience. Required skills include the ability to build rapport, work at heights (up to 40 feet), lift over 70 lbs, and possess a valid driver's license with a safe driving record. Tools and equipment provided include a DISH-supplied van and necessary installation tools. The role may require travel and is subject to a pre-employment screen, including a drug test. Job Title: Order Builder  
Company: Coca-Cola Bottling Company UNITED, Inc.  
Division: North Alabama  
Department: Oxford Warehouse Loading  
Work Schedule: M-F, 8 am until finished

The role requires identifying products by description and quantity, sorting materials on pallets, marking items with identifying information, and recording amounts received or distributed. 

Required skills include the ability to read, write, and speak English, maintain a neat appearance, and adhere to safety policies. Job Title: Mountain Multimedia Journalist

The role involves shooting video and still photos, editing multimedia content for various platforms, appearing on TV, and collaborating with photojournalists and news producers. Required qualifications include a bachelor's degree in broadcast journalism or a related field, with 3+ years of experience preferred. Technical skills needed are computer literacy, videography, non-linear editing (preferably with Final Cut Pro), strong writing skills in broadcast and AP style, and proficiency in posting content online. The position requires self-motivation, the ability to work under deadlines, and the capability to lift up to 50 pounds. A valid driver's license and good driving record are necessary. Job Title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)  
Company: BAYADA Home Health Care

Job Title: Human Resources Project Manager  
Company: Sunrise Systems, Inc.

Key tasks involve creating HR training programs and communications, maintaining project documentation (project plans, status reports, issue logs, change control), and managing project risks and issues. Job Title: Clinical Paramedic  
Location: Garyville, Louisiana  
Company: Marathon Petroleum Corporation  

The Clinical Paramedic is responsible for administering and coordinating Occupational Health Services for employees and contractors at the Garyville LA Refinery Occupational Health Clinic. Key responsibilities include evaluating illnesses and injuries, providing follow-up care, conducting OSHA mandated medical surveillance exams, and performing drug and alcohol specimen collections. The role requires maintaining clinic schedules, ordering supplies, providing onsite training in emergency medical response, and acting as a subject matter expert for the local Emergency Response Team. Required qualifications include a High School Diploma or GED, an active Paramedic License, and 3-5 years of paramedic experience, preferably in an occupational health setting. Familiarity with OSHA, DOT, ADA, HIPAA, FMLA, and Workers’ Compensation regulations is necessary. Skills required include blood work competence, strong problem-solving abilities, effective communication, and customer service skills. The position involves physical activities such as standing, walking, and lifting up to 30 pounds, within a fast-paced medical office environment. Less than 10% travel is expected.
